# Oriveo Community Edition

> Oriveo Community Edition is an open-source, bring-your-own-key (BYOK) AI chat client for iOS,
> Android and the web, with a native macOS client in development. You use API keys you already own
> with fifteen model providers, or with any OpenAI-, Anthropic- or Gemini-compatible endpoint,
> including a model server running on your own machine. There is no account and no subscription,
> and conversations stay on the device.

The clients are native and separate: SwiftUI on iOS, Jetpack Compose on Android, Next.js on the
web. They share one definition of how to talk to a provider — request recipes, capability
contracts, and recorded upstream byte streams — and all three assert against the same fixtures.
Built-in providers are OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Grok, Mistral, Groq,
Together AI, Fireworks AI, MiniMax, Z.ai, Qwen, Kimi and SiliconFlow; a relay connection reaches
anything else, including llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM and Open WebUI. The interface ships in sixteen
languages. The only request the app makes on its own behalf is a read-only, unauthenticated model
catalog, which you can point at your own host. Licensed AGPL-3.0-or-later.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/oriveo/oriveo/blob/main/README.md): what Oriveo is, why it exists, the full feature list, the provider table, the architecture, and how to build each client
- [Get started](https://github.com/oriveo/oriveo/blob/main/README.md#get-started): the shortest path to a running app on web, iOS or Android
- [FAQ](https://github.com/oriveo/oriveo/blob/main/README.md#faq): what BYOK means, whether conversations pass through a server, running a model locally, macOS, and interface languages
- [Privacy](https://github.com/oriveo/oriveo/blob/main/README.md#privacy): where provider keys and conversations are stored on each platform, and what leaves the device

## Clients

- [iOS](https://github.com/oriveo/oriveo/blob/main/ios/README.md): SwiftUI with a UIKit transcript and GRDB storage; iOS 18 and later
- [Android](https://github.com/oriveo/oriveo/blob/main/android/README.md): Jetpack Compose with Room, Koin and Ktor/OkHttp; Android 8 and later
- [Web](https://github.com/oriveo/oriveo/blob/main/web/README.md): Next.js App Router with React, Zustand and TypeScript; self-hostable, Node 22
- [macOS](https://github.com/oriveo/oriveo/blob/main/macos/README.md): a native client in development, arriving in the coming months
- [Shared contracts](https://github.com/oriveo/oriveo/blob/main/shared/README.md): capability recipes, model contracts, recorded provider fixtures, and the OriveoProviderKit Swift package

## Project

- [Contributing](https://github.com/oriveo/oriveo/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): toolchain versions, how to build and test each client, and what a good pull request looks like
